words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer reads the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder).

As the buyer, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 2 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” equals true.
